# transition task

Request a state on another state-machine task.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `statement.transition_task` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Statements |
| Family | State Control |
| Monaco kind | `statement` |
| Format | `transition <portal/name> to <state>` |
| Valid contexts | `state_machine_execution` |
| Autocomplete | `transition tasks/name to state_name` |

## Example

```lua
transition tasks/name to state_name
```
